neoforge.screen.mods.info.description.ka:
Highly configurable PaperDoll mod.
Fork of Ayame PaperDoll, itself forked from Extra Player Renderer.
config.kartoneks_paperdoll.option.visual:
Adjust the PaperDoll's appearance through a visual interface.

§eLeft Click§r: Adjust the PaperDoll's position.
§eRight Click§r: Adjust the PaperDoll's rotation.
§eMouse Wheel§r: Adjust the PaperDoll's size.
Visual Configuration Editor is only available in-game.
config.kartoneks_paperdoll.option.rotati:
Adjust player's rotation mode.

§eUnlock§r: Allows the player to rotate freely.
§eLock§r: Fixes the player's facing direction.
Determines the vertical offset of head rotation in degrees.
config.kartoneks_paperdoll.option.pitch_: Determines the number of degrees the head can rotate up or down.
config.kartoneks_paperdoll.option.head_y: Determines the horizontal offset of head rotation in degrees.
Determines the number of degrees the head can rotate left or right.
config.kartoneks_paperdoll.option.body_y: Determines the horizontal offset of body rotation in degrees.
Determines the number of degrees the body can rotate left or right.
config.kartoneks_paperdoll.option.pose_o:
Method of offsetting player's position when the player changes its pose.

§eAuto§r: Adjust height according to the height of entity's eyes.
§eManual§r: Manually set the offset when sneaking, swimming, using elytra and crawling.
§eForce Standing§r: Only renders in standing pose.
§eDisabled§r: No offset.
config.kartoneks_paperdoll.option.sneak_:
Y offset when player is sneaking.

Works only when §aPosture Offset Method§r is set to §eManual§r.
config.kartoneks_paperdoll.option.swim_c:
Y offset when player is swimming or crawling.

Works only when §aPosture Offset Method§r is set to §eManual§r.
config.kartoneks_paperdoll.option.elytra:
Y offset when player is flying using an elytra.

Works only when §aPosture Offset Method§r is set to §eManual§r.
config.kartoneks_paperdoll.option.hurt_f: If rendered model turns red when player takes damage.
config.kartoneks_paperdoll.option.swing_: If the rendered hands swing when trying to break blocks.
config.kartoneks_paperdoll.option.light_: The degree of light source producing shadow effects.
config.kartoneks_paperdoll.option.use_wo: If use the light level in the world to render.
config.kartoneks_paperdoll.option.world_: Minimum brightness when useWorldLight is enabled.
config.kartoneks_paperdoll.option.render: Render the vehicle, does not work when §aPosture Offset Method§r is §eForce Standing§r.
config.kartoneks_paperdoll.option.pause_: Whether to pause the game when the configuration screen is open. (effective in single-player only)
config.kartoneks_paperdoll.option.disabl: Controls whether the background blur effect is displayed on the in-game configuration screen.
config.kartoneks_paperdoll.option.visibl: Whether to display only during sprinting, jumping, flying, sitting, swimming, crawling, or flying with elytra.
config.kartoneks_paperdoll.option.hide_o: Hide when a screen (e.g., game menu or inventory) is open.
config.kartoneks_paperdoll.option.specta:
Automatically switch entity model in spectator mode.

Overrides §2Player Name§r option if enabled.
config.kartoneks_paperdoll.option.player: The name of the player to render. It will be your name when left blank.

config.kartoneks_paperdoll.screen.title: Kartoneks Paperdoll Settings
config.kartoneks_paperdoll.screen.reset_: Every Kartoneks Paperdoll option goes back to its default.
config.kartoneks_paperdoll.screen.note.n: Join a world to see the live preview
config.kartoneks_paperdoll.screen.note.h: The paper doll is turned off
config.kartoneks_paperdoll.screen.why.lo: Only when Rotation Mode is Lock.
config.kartoneks_paperdoll.screen.why.ma: Only when Posture Offset Method is Manual.
config.kartoneks_paperdoll.screen.why.st: Does nothing while Posture Offset Method is Force Standing.
config.kartoneks_paperdoll.option.auto_h:
Works like the paper doll in Bedrock Edition: it shows up while you move, jump, sneak, sprint, swim, fly, ride, fight or use items, and hides after a few seconds of standing still.

The show/hide key brings it back right away.

Seconds of standing still before the paper doll hides.

Works only when §aHide When Idle§r is on.
